_doc: THE BEDROCK DIALECT'S DECLARED REFUSALS beyond the Converse/ConverseStream error list: the runtime answers each listed busbar refusal kind with exactly this exception and HTTP status (error_kind_to_bedrock_type reads this table), and the llm conformance rig reads the same table, so the plane emits only what it declares. Each row cites the owner's ruling.

refusals.ruling: OWNER 2026-10-27: a spent budget is refused with 1.5.5's non-retryable 400 ServiceQuotaExceededException (InvokeModel's), not the Converse-declared ThrottlingException every AWS SDK retries.
